RULE_001.name: Repeated Failed Authentication (Possible Brute Force)
RULE_001.description: Triggers when repeated failed authentication attempts occur from the same source IP within the configured time window.

RULE_002.name: Multiple Target Accounts (Potential Password Spraying)
RULE_002.description: Triggers when one source IP fails authentication against multiple distinct usernames within the configured time window.

RULE_003.name: Suspicious Success After Failures
RULE_003.description: Triggers when a successful authentication follows repeated failures from the same source IP and username.

RULE_004.name: High-Volume Authentication Failures
RULE_004.description: Triggers when total authentication failures across a monitored device exceed the configured threshold.

RULE_005.name: Repeat Offender Activity
RULE_005.description: Triggers when a previously flagged source IP continues suspicious failed authentication behavior.
